name: layout
description: BaseHead, BaseLayout, SiteHeader (mobile menu), SiteFooter, Breadcrumbs, skip link; head/SEO model and nav as unit-tested TS.
next: Edit src/data/site.json, nav.json, footer.json (placeholder origin and @yourhandle force noindex until replaced).
BaseLayout imports global.css and layout/layout.css itself; global.css must @import './themes/index.css'.
Wrap pages: <BaseLayout title="About" description="...">; put <ThemeToggle slot="theme-toggle" /> in the header.
Add real public/favicon.svg, apple-touch-icon.png, manifest.webmanifest, og-default.png (brand-doctor).

Static pages need `export const prerender = true;` in their frontmatter (the starter is SSR), or dist/client has no HTML and discovery-doctor reports a missing homepage. Before discovery-doctor: set PUBLIC_SECURITY_CONTACT (mailto:...) and run `<pm> run build:headers:prod` (writes the security headers).
